title: Javascript alert windows works on Mac but not on Windows
body:
**Describe the bug**
`alert` works on Mac but not on Windows after `yarn tauri build`

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Using following code
```
useEffect(()=>{
        return ()=>{
            alert("Item about to be deleted!");
        }
    },[]);
```

2. Before using Tauri to build, this alert works both on Windows and Mac as expected.
3. After using Tauri to build, this alert only works on Mac but not on Windows.

**Expected behavior**
Expect a consistent result. 

**Screenshots**
Screenshot can be found at: https://github.com/xudesheng/mytodo

When you click `delete`, you can see an alert windows pops up on Mac but not on Windows.
